task.title: P6-131: Clear last_good on a fresh query so stale results stop leaking across queries
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-131. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/catalog-search.md.

**`last_good` is never cleared on a fresh query, so a grammar error on page one renders *page N* results as the dimmed "stale" set underneath it** (was `P6-042e`; `catalog.rs:180-184`). Re-key `last_good` on `url_q` change.
